Support for Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server Debezium Connector

Hi Everyone,
We are trying to connect to Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server through Debezium Connector Debezium connector for PostgreSQL :: Debezium Documentation
, we followed the document to provide the roles and privilege, but even giving all the roles and access to the newly created debezium_group , we are facing error mentioned below, while setting up the connector in confluent cloud.
The connector keeps on failing with below error message.
ERROR: permission denied for database

evidence.quote: By default, the connector will create the \"dbz_publication\" as \"ALL TABLES\", which requires SUPERUSER privileges, which your connector user account likely does not have."; reporter: "it worked.

notes: Connector user lacked the privilege needed for the default publication.autocreate.mode=all_tables; PostgresReplicationConnection.initPublication shows the CREATE PUBLICATION FOR ALL TABLES that needs it. Fixed by grants or pre-created publication.
